He wrote the date in the log, then rang the harbour office on the telephone at ten past seven.", "w02": "天还黑着。四点整，环卫工推着三轮车出了胡同口。扫帚划过路面，一下一下。早点铺的灯先亮了，老板揭开蒸笼，白气顶起锅盖。第一班公交车停在站牌下，司机坐着喝茶，车里没人。送奶工把木箱撂在楼道口，转身骑走。远处高架桥上，一辆货车开过，声音传了很久。", "w03": "- Recursion means solving a big job by doing a smaller copy of the same job.\n- Take a box with a smaller box inside, and another inside that one. You open each box to get to the next.\n- The last box is empty, so you stop there and close the boxes back up in order."}
